svg.aria-label: Himalayan Sakura: an animated ASCII anime short about a traveler climbing from a sakura tree at dawn, through a sea of clouds, to a starlit summit
svg.text: EP.01 - DAWN AT THE FOOT OF THE HIMALAYA
EP.02 - ABOVE THE SEA OF CLOUDS
Every summit begins at the foot of a mountain.
Under the sakura, a traveler sets out for the peaks.
The trail climbs. The world falls away below.
Through the clouds, one step at a time.
At the top, the stars feel close enough to touch.
